GameConditionDef.label: curse
GameConditionDef.description: The curse is hanging over this place. Don't do anything dangerous.

GameConditionDef.label: curse: dining
GameConditionDef.description: The curse of dining is hanging over this place. Everyone must eat at a table.

GameConditionDef.label: curse: research
GameConditionDef.description: The curse of research is hanging over this place. No one may perform research or scanning work.

GameConditionDef.label: curse: killing animals
GameConditionDef.description: The curse of killing is hanging over this place. No innocent animal may be killed.

GameConditionDef.label: curse: getting wounded
GameConditionDef.description: The curse of wounds is hanging over this place. No one may suffer any harm.

GameConditionDef.label: curse: cutting trees
GameConditionDef.description: The curse of lumbering is hanging over this place. No tree may be cut down.
